title: Zymoclean Gel DNA Recovery
author: Sze-Xian Lim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zx4f7qw

steps.title: Excise DNA fragment
steps.instruction: Excise the DNA fragment from the agarose gel using a razor blade, scalpel, or other device and transfer it into a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Determine gel weight
steps.instruction: Weight the tubes containing the agarose gel and subtract the weight of the empty tube to determine the gel volume/weight.

steps.title: Add ADB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 3 volumes of ADB to each volume of agarose excised from the gel (e.g., add 300 µL ADB to every 100 mg agarose gel).

steps.title: Dissolve agarose gel
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C to 55 °C for 5 to 10 minutes until the gel slice is completely dissolved.

steps.title: Load and centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the melted agarose solution to a Zymo-Spin™ Column in a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 30 to 60 seconds.

steps.title: Wash DNA column
steps.instruction: Wash the column twice using DNA Wash Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL DNA Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds.
Repeat the wash by adding another 200 µL DNA Wash Buffer and centrifuging for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the column matrix.

substeps.instruction: Add at least 6 µL DNA Elution Buffer directly to the column matrix.
Place the column into a 1.5 ml tube and centrifuge for 30 to 60 seconds to elute the DNA.
